part_title: PART P — SETTINGS > ACCOUNTS & BACK OFFICE

slides.heading: P1 — Accounts hub
slides.where: Location: Settings > Accounts, or menu Accounts
slides.note: Accounts hub consolidates all cashier tenders and expenditure tracking.
steps: Open Settings and select Accounts tab (or Accounts menu).
Access payment types, expense management, and ledgers.
Review financial dashboard and cash registers.
Connect fiscal accounting parameters.
Manage day close routines from centralized hub.

slides.heading: P2 — Payment types
slides.note: Disabling unused payment methods prevents drawer reconciliation mistakes.
steps: Open Payment types under Accounts tab.
Keep Cash, Card, and used tender types active.
Disable unused payment types to prevent cashier errors.
Configure SoftPOS / terminal integration settings.
Save payment types configuration.

slides.heading: P3 — Expense types
slides.note: Clear expense types simplify monthly profit and loss analysis.
steps: Open Expense types in Accounts settings.
Create standard expense categories (Rent, Electricity, Gas, Cleaning).
Assign accounting codes if required.
Save expense types.
Enables structured operational cost categorization.

slides.heading: P4 — Expense details
slides.note: Log expenses promptly to maintain accurate real-time cash drawer balances.
steps: Open Expense details to record paid operational costs.
Select branch, date, and expense category.
Enter paid amount and invoice / receipt reference note.
Attach receipt photo or voucher if supported.
Save for monthly P&L and cost auditing.

slides.heading: P5 — Sales Ledger
slides.note: Always review Sales Ledger before performing evening cashier handover.
steps: Open Sales Ledger in Back Office.
Review current day gross sales, net sales, and tax totals.
Inspect breakdown across payment tenders (Cash, Card, Online).
Audit voided items and applied discounts.
Verify sales reconciliation prior to executing day close.

slides.heading: P6 — Day Close
slides.note: Day Close locks the business day; only authorized managers should close.
steps: Settle all open tables and pending tickets across the branch.
Perform physical cash count of drawer contents.
Enter actual counted cash into Day Close screen.
Review calculated cash variance (over / short).
Confirm Day Close and archive official closing report.

slides.heading: P7 — Shift (Cash Drawer Shift)
slides.note: Shift management is independent of staff attendance time clock.
steps: Open Shift management in Back Office.
Start new shift by recording opening cash float.
Cashiers operate drawer under active shift session.
Perform midday or shift-change count upon handover.
Close shift with handover report between outgoing and incoming cashier.

slides.heading: P8 — Time clock
slides.note: Accurate time clock logs ensure transparent employee payroll compliance.
steps: Staff clock in upon arrival at the restaurant.
Clock out during meal breaks or end of scheduled shift.
Review daily attendance logs and total logged hours.
Export timesheet data for payroll and salary processing.
Time clock records staff attendance, distinct from till Day Close.
